desc: Kimber's new CDS9 (Covert Double Stack 9mm) is the pinnacle of design for the modern everyday carry handgun owner. Built to be a fully featured personal protection firearm, the Kimber CDS9 delivers several attributes that place this model in its own class. A fully ambidextrous handgun with a reversible magazine release that delivers increased capacity is a hallmark for today's modern concealed carry owner. Available as an optics-ready model compatible with all RMSc optic footprints. A stacked recoil spring assembly for increased life up to 10,000 rounds.
